themes_detail.label: Graffiti explosion in Ridgewood
themes_detail.summary: Graffiti complaints skyrocketed to 21 THIS WEEK compared to a baseline of 0.8 per week over the prior 8 weeks—a 2,600% spike (z-score: 24.42)—suggesting a coordinated tagging campaign or sudden increase in vandalism that warrants immediate street-level reporting.
evidence: 21 graffiti complaints THIS WEEK vs. 0.8 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 24.42 indicates extreme statistical anomaly
This is the single largest spike across all 311 complaint categories tracked
reporting_angles: Ground survey of high-graffiti corridors (Forest Ave, Myrtle Ave, Fresh Pond Rd) to document scale and targets
Interview residents and business owners on whether this reflects organized crews or new vandal activity

themes_detail.label: Electrical hazards surge
themes_detail.summary: Electrical complaints jumped to 7 THIS WEEK versus a baseline of 1.0 per week (600% spike, z-score: 5.37), raising potential safety concerns around aging infrastructure or recent weather damage that could pose fire or shock risks.
evidence: 7 electrical complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.0 weekly baseline over prior 8 weeks
Z-score of 5.37 indicates statistically significant spike
Aligns with CB's long-standing budget request for additional DOB building inspectors
reporting_angles: Contact Con Edison and DOB to determine if outages, equipment failures, or inspection findings preceded the spike
Identify if complaints cluster in specific blocks or buildings (aging housing stock areas)

themes_detail.label: Damaged street signs proliferate
themes_detail.summary: Street sign damage complaints reached 10 THIS WEEK compared to a 2.5 weekly average (300% spike, z-score: 7.5), indicating either collision damage, weather impacts, or systemic maintenance failures affecting pedestrian navigation and safety.
evidence: 10 street sign complaints THIS WEEK vs. 2.5 weekly baseline
May correlate with recent accidents, severe weather, or construction activity
reporting_angles: Check NYC DOT work orders and accident reports from past 2 weeks in Ridgewood/Glendale area
Photograph damaged signs to document whether damage is from collisions, weather, or deferred maintenance

themes_detail.label: Illegal posting campaign spreading
themes_detail.summary: Illegal posting complaints spiked to 17 COMPLAINTS 2 WEEKS AGO versus a baseline of 0.5 per week (3,300% spike, z-score: 16.5), suggesting organized poster placement or a failure in enforcement that warrants follow-up to see if the trend continues.
evidence: 17 illegal posting complaints 2 WEEKS AGO vs. 0.5 weekly baseline
Spike may have receded; verification of current status needed
reporting_angles: Check if 2-week-old spike has continued or if enforcement cleared the postings; re-sample street conditions
Contact NYC DOT Enforcement to determine if specific event (concert, election campaign, real estate push) triggered the surge

themes_detail.label: Emergency response complaints rise sharply
themes_detail.summary: Emergency Response Team complaints jumped to 4 LAST WEEK compared to a baseline of 0.6 per week (540% spike, z-score: 6.97), possibly reflecting increased 911 calls, mental health crises, or police/EMS activity that residents are reporting—warrants clarification of what incidents triggered complaints.
evidence: 4 ERT complaints LAST WEEK vs. 0.6 weekly baseline
311 complaints about ERT typically reflect resident concerns about police response, not ERT performance itself
reporting_angles: Request NYPD Compstat data for CD 405 to see if crime complaints, mental health incidents, or domestic violence calls spiked
Interview community members about what triggered ERT complaints (noise, aggression, response time)
